visual_action: A slideshow of still photos shows President Joe Biden in various settings: at an ice cream parlor counter with other customers, holding a cup of ice cream while wearing sunglasses, at a Dairy Queen holding a Blizzard upside down, holding a soft-serve cone, and handing something to a young boy in front of an ice cream truck.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: He is the subject of every photograph in the slideshow and is named in the on-screen text 'from President Biden'.

editing_pacing: A simple slideshow of still photographs.
central_claim: President Joe Biden is a relatable figure who enjoys simple pleasures like celebrating National Ice Cream Day.
intended_effect: To foster a positive and relatable image of President Biden.
